integrity_statement: Proof and all finite checks are described explicitly. Finite cases are corroborative rather than an infinite certificate. The originating chain terminology is used as motivation, not as an unverified equivalence of conventions.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is only for the explicitly defined complete two-level halfspace bodies, with integer group sizes at least one; no general signed-poset volume or Ehrhart theorem is asserted. An older differently named bounded-Lipschitz volume formula could overlap.
title: Exact volume and strict imbalance law for two-level signed-chain polytopes
